resumeText:
Sandeep Yadav | Lucknow | sandeep.yadav@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Sales Officer - Home Loans, Gomti Housing Finance Ltd, Lucknow (2022 - present)
- Sourced home loan and LAP files through 12 active DSAs and three builder tie-ups in Gomti Nagar and Sushant Golf City.
- Explained home loan, loan against property and PMAY subsidy options to salaried and self-employed customers.
- Checked FOIR and income eligibility before logging each file.
- Collected ITR, bank statements and property papers and prepared complete login files.
- Verified KYC documents and completed video KYC for walk-in customers.
- Tracked every file from login to sanction and disbursement with the credit and operations teams.
- Met 8 to 10 customers a day through field visits at builder sites and offices.

Field Sales Executive - Credit Cards, Avadh Card Services, Lucknow (2020 - 2022)
- Sold credit cards to salaried customers at corporate offices.

EDUCATION
BCom, University of Lucknow, 2020

SKILLS
Insurance cross-sell, CIBIL, MS Excel
